AI.keywords: 因果未来-令牌蒸馏, 世界动作模型, 传送带操作, 视觉-语言-动作策略, 动态抓取
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种巧妙的方法，通过因果未来-令牌蒸馏，在不增加部署成本的情况下，将世界模型的预测能力融入到VLA策略中。其创新点在于如何有效地从冻结的WAM中提取未来信息并将其转化为可用于VLM前缀和动作专家的条件，同时保持推理的因果性。在动态抓取任务上的显著性能提升，特别是对于快速移动物体，证明了该方法的有效性和重要性。

title: Beyond Endpoint Gains: A Weight-Delta Audit of Medical Specialization
summary: Specialist language models are usually understood through endpoint gains: the generalist scores lower, the specialist scores higher, and the difference is treated as evidence of specialization. This leaves the released update itself largely unexamined. We propose a paired weight-delta path audit and apply it to two public, aligned generalist-to-medical-specialist checkpoint pairs: Gemma-3-4B-IT to MedGemma-4B-IT and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to HuatuoGPT-o1-7B. In both pairs, the full decoder-side update strongly reconstructs measured medical benchmark movement (0.974 and 1.183 endpoint-normalized retention), making each decoder delta an appropriate substrate for the audit. Yet the movement is not cleanly localized. MLP is the strongest broad component family in both pairs, but mixed off-domain movements, 10-seed matched controls, and endpoint-anchored rollbacks prevent a unique coarse-family explanation. The audit therefore separates update-level reconstruction from component-level explanation. Its claims concern text-only multiple-choice benchmark movement, not clinical validation, repair, or circuit-level mechanism.

AI.title_translation: 超越端点增益：医学专业化中的权重-增量审计
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种权重-增量路径审计方法，用于检查通用模型到医学专业模型更新过程中权重变化的具体影响，发现更新主要集中在MLP组件，且专业化过程比简单的端点增益更复杂。
AI.motivation: 现有对专业化语言模型的理解主要通过端点增益进行，即比较通用模型和专业模型的得分差异，而模型更新本身（权重变化）则很少被审视。
AI.method: 提出了一种配对的权重-增量路径审计方法，并将其应用于两个公开的通用到医学专业模型检查点对：Gemma-3-4B-IT到MedGemma-4B-IT，以及Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct到HuatuoGPT-o1-7B。
AI.result: 在两个模型对中，完整的解码器侧更新都能强烈重构测得的医学基准表现（0.974和1.183的端点归一化保留率），表明解码器增量是审计的合适载体。然而，这种变动并非清晰地局部化。MLP是两个模型对中最强的广泛组件族，但混合的跨领域变动、10-seed匹配对照和端点锚定回滚排除了单一粗粒度族解释。
AI.conclusion: 审计将更新层面的重构与组件层面的解释区分开来。其主张仅涉及纯文本多项选择基准的变动，而不涉及临床验证、修复或电路层面的机制。
AI.translation: 专业语言模型通常通过端点增益来理解：通用模型得分较低，专业模型得分较高，这种差异被视为专业化的证据。这使得已发布的更新本身在很大程度上未被检查。我们提出了一种配对的权重-增量路径审计，并将其应用于两个公开的、对齐的通用到医学专业检查点对：Gemma-3-4B-IT到MedGemma-4B-IT和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct到HuatuoGPT-o1-7B。在这两对中，完整的解码器侧更新强烈重构了测得的医学基准变动（0.974和1.183的端点归一化保留率），使得每个解码器增量成为审计的合适基底。然而，这种变动并非清晰地局部化。MLP是两对模型中最强的广泛组件族，但混合的跨领域变动、10个种子匹配的对照和以端点为锚点的回滚排除了独特的粗粒度族解释。因此，审计将更新层面的重构与组件层面的解释区分开来。其主张仅涉及纯文本多项选择基准的变动，而不涉及临床验证、修复或电路层面的机制。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种“权重-增量路径审计”方法，旨在深入分析通用语言模型向医学专业模型转变过程中权重更新的具体机制，而非仅关注最终性能提升。研究对Gemma-3-4B-IT到MedGemma-4B-IT和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct到HuatuoGPT-o1-7B模型对进行了审计，发现解码器侧的权重更新能有效解释医学基准性能的变化。结果显示，模型专业化主要体现在多层感知器（MLP）组件，但其权重变化并非单一或局部化，且涉及复杂的跨领域影响。该审计强调区分模型更新的整体重构能力与组件层面的具体解释，其结论仅限于文本基准表现而非临床有效性。
AI.keywords: 权重-增量审计, 医学专业化, 语言模型, MLP, 模型更新
AI.comments: 本文通过引入“权重-增量路径审计”方法，创新性地超越了传统仅关注模型端点性能的评估方式，深入探究了模型专业化过程中权重变化的微观机制。这种方法对于理解大型语言模型如何获取特定领域知识、优化模型训练策略以及进行模型诊断具有重要意义。它揭示了专业化并非简单的局部调整，而是涉及复杂且分布式的权重更新，特别是MLP层面的显著作用。局限性在于其结论目前仅限于文本基准表现，尚未扩展到临床验证。

title: GhostTac: Manipulating Tactile Sensors without Physical Contact
summary: Tactile sensors are integral components of modern robotic systems, enabling robots to perceive and interact with the physical environment through tactile feedback. Despite their importance, the physical-layer security of tactile sensors has received little attention in prior work. In this paper, we present GhostTac, to the best of our knowledge, the first contactless attack that manipulates tactile sensing via electromagnetic interference (EMI). We identify that EMI exploits the nonlinear rectification and limited bandwidth amplification effects, allowing carefully crafted EMI signals to be converted into a persistent DC offset that bypasses on-board filtering and induces stable measurement deviations. Building on this mechanism, GhostTac enables fine-grained and controllable manipulation of sensor outputs by reshaping the spatial distribution and manipulating the magnitude at the targeted location. Such interference can induce unintended and harmful robot behaviors, such as causing a domestic robot to exert excessive force, resulting in physical damage or human injury. We evaluate GhostTac on 10 sensor modules and 2 dexterous hands, covering 15 tactile sensors of different types, and demonstrate consistent attack effectiveness across all tested devices. We further present three case studies on tactile grasping, slip detection, and material classification to illustrate practical impacts in real robotic tasks. We envision that our findings shed light on a new physical attack vector against tactile sensing in robotic systems.

AI.title_translation: GhostTac: 无物理接触操纵触觉传感器
AI.tldr: GhostTac是一种通过电磁干扰（EMI）在不接触的情况下操纵触觉传感器的新型攻击，利用非线性整流和有限带宽放大效应，可导致稳定的测量偏差，对机器人系统构成新的物理攻击威胁。
AI.motivation: 触觉传感器是现代机器人系统的关键组成部分，但其物理层安全性在以往工作中受到的关注很少。本文旨在解决这一安全漏洞，展示一种无接触攻击方法。
AI.method: GhostTac通过电磁干扰（EMI）实现无接触操纵触觉传感。它利用EMI信号在触觉传感器中发生的非线性整流和有限带宽放大效应，将精心设计的EMI信号转化为持久的直流偏移，从而绕过板载滤波并诱导稳定的测量偏差。通过重塑空间分布和操纵目标位置的幅度，GhostTac可以实现对传感器输出的精细和可控操纵。
AI.result: GhostTac在10个传感器模块和2个灵巧手（涵盖15种不同类型的触觉传感器）上进行了评估，结果表明在所有测试设备上都具有一致的攻击有效性。通过触觉抓取、滑移检测和材料分类的三个案例研究，进一步证明了其在实际机器人任务中的实际影响，例如导致家用机器人施加过大力量，造成物理损坏或人身伤害。
AI.conclusion: 本文的研究结果揭示了机器人系统中针对触觉传感的一种新的物理攻击向量。
AI.translation: 触觉传感器是现代机器人系统的组成部分，使机器人能够通过触觉反馈感知和与物理环境交互。尽管它们很重要，但触觉传感器的物理层安全性在以前的工作中很少受到关注。在本文中，我们提出了GhostTac，据我们所知，这是第一个通过电磁干扰（EMI）操纵触觉传感的无接触攻击。我们发现EMI利用了非线性整流和有限带宽放大效应，允许精心制作的EMI信号转换为持久的直流偏移，从而绕过板载滤波并诱导稳定的稳定测量偏差。在此机制的基础上，GhostTac通过重塑空间分布和操纵目标位置的幅度，实现了对传感器输出的精细和可控操纵。这种干扰可能导致意想不到的有害机器人行为，例如导致家用机器人施加过大的力量，从而导致物理损坏或人身伤害。我们在10个传感器模块和2个灵巧手上评估了GhostTac，涵盖了15种不同类型的触觉传感器，并证明了所有测试设备上的一致攻击有效性。我们进一步提出了触觉抓取、滑移检测和材料分类的三个案例研究，以说明在实际机器人任务中的实际影响。我们设想我们的发现揭示了机器人系统中针对触觉传感的一种新的物理攻击向量。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了GhostTac，一种通过电磁干扰（EMI）实现无接触操纵触觉传感器的新型攻击方法。该方法利用EMI在传感器中产生的非线性整流和有限带宽放大效应，将EMI信号转化为稳定的直流偏移，从而绕过滤波器并导致可控的测量偏差。实验证明GhostTac对多种触觉传感器和机器人手具有一致的攻击效果，并在抓取、滑移检测和材料分类等实际任务中展示了潜在危害，揭示了机器人系统触觉传感的新物理攻击向量。
AI.keywords: 触觉传感器, 电磁干扰, 无接触攻击, 机器人安全, 物理层安全
AI.comments: GhostTac的创新之处在于首次揭示了通过电磁干扰对触觉传感器进行无接触操纵的可能性，填补了触觉传感器物理层安全研究的空白。其重要性在于提醒研究人员和工程师关注机器人系统中触觉传感器的潜在安全漏洞，并为未来设计更安全的机器人系统提供了新的视角。该研究的局限性可能在于未深入探讨具体的防护措施。

title: In-Cell Learning: Deployed Language Models Can Learn New Knowledge Without Changing a Single Stored Bit
summary: A deployed language model is a file that many things depend on - a benchmark report, a certification, a fleet of devices - and every way of teaching it something new produces a different file. We show that this is not necessary. A 4-bit release stores each weight as an integer code and a shared scale, and leaves between the stored values an interval the quantizer discards; we call in-cell learning the paradigm in which new knowledge is written only into that interval, so that re-quantizing the served weights reproduces the released codes and scales exactly. The guarantee is checked in the integer domain on every weight, the update is a separate file (a fill) that can be withdrawn by subtraction, and drift is bounded by radii the grid fixes before training. CellFill realizes the paradigm by construction: a low-rank position inside the cell, trained on the vendor's own 4-bit release. On those releases - NF4, QAT and GPTQ-style grids, Qwen3 and Gemma, 1.7B to 31B - CellFill writes 83 to 97 percent of a corpus of real facts the models verifiably did not know, with zero violations over up to 2.4 x 10^10 constrained weights. We demonstrate the knowledge is usable: injected drugs compose with injected ingredients at the model's own two-hop ceiling, and a post-cutoff software library is used in code at 2.6 times chance. Against retrieval on PopQA's long tail, the fill answers 82 to 90 percent of questions the released model could not, at 75 tokens per question against 90 to 1008. Several writers can share one release, sequential updates consume a constant fraction of the remaining room, and the archived result files behind every table are at https://github.com/sumsliu/cellfill.

AI.title_translation: 单元内学习：已部署的语言模型无需改变任何存储位即可学习新知识
AI.tldr: 已部署的语言模型可以通过“单元内学习”范式，在不改变原始存储位的情况下学习新知识，该方法利用量化间隔写入新信息，并由CellFill实现，效果显著且高效。
AI.motivation: 已部署的语言模型在更新知识时，每次更新都会生成一个不同的文件，这给基准报告、认证和设备群带来了问题。本文旨在解决这一问题，实现无需改变原始存储位即可更新知识。
AI.method: 本文提出“单元内学习”范式，即在4位量化模型中，将新知识写入存储值之间被量化器丢弃的间隔中。这样可以确保重新量化时能精确复制原始代码和尺度。更新以独立文件（一个“填充”）的形式存在。CellFill通过在单元内构建一个低秩位置来实现这一范式，并在供应商的4位版本上进行训练。
AI.result: CellFill在多种4位量化语言模型（NF4, QAT, GPTQ-style grids, Qwen3, Gemma, 1.7B至31B）上注入了83%至97%的真实新事实，且在高达2.4 x 10^10个受约束权重上零违规。注入的知识是可用的，例如药物成分组合和软件库使用。在PopQA的长尾问题上，CellFill解决了发布模型无法回答的82%至90%的问题，且每个问题仅使用75个token，远少于检索方法的90至1008个token。多个写入者可以共享一个发布模型，并且顺序更新仅消耗剩余空间的固定比例。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的单元内学习范式，由CellFill实现，为已部署的语言模型提供了一种有效且高效的学习新知识的方法，而无需修改原始模型文件，从而确保了兼容性并实现了灵活的更新。
AI.translation: 已部署的语言模型是一个许多事物所依赖的文件——基准报告、认证、设备群——而每种教它新知识的方法都会产生一个不同的文件。我们表明这并非必要。一个4位版本将每个权重存储为整数代码和一个共享尺度，并在存储值之间留下量化器丢弃的间隔；我们称“单元内学习”为一种范式，其中新知识只写入该间隔，这样重新量化已服务的权重就能精确复制已发布的代码和尺度。这种保证在整数域中对每个权重进行检查，更新是一个单独的文件（一个填充），可以通过减法撤回，并且漂移受到网格在训练前固定的半径的限制。CellFill通过构建实现了这一范式：在单元内部的一个低秩位置，在供应商自己的4位版本上进行训练。在这些版本上——NF4、QAT和GPTQ风格的网格、Qwen3和Gemma，从1.7B到31B——CellFill写入了模型可验证地不知道的真实事实语料库的83%到97%，在高达2.4 x 10^10个受约束权重上零违规。我们证明了这些知识是可用的：注入的药物与注入的成分在模型的两跳上限处组合，并且一个截止后的软件库在代码中以2.6倍于偶然的概率被使用。在PopQA的长尾问题上，针对检索，填充回答了发布模型无法回答的82%到90%的问题，每个问题使用75个token，而检索需要90到1008个token。多个写入者可以共享一个发布，顺序更新消耗剩余空间的恒定比例，并且每个表格后面的存档结果文件可在https://github.com/sumsliu/cellfill获取。
AI.summary: 已部署的语言模型在更新时面临生成新文件的挑战。本文提出“单元内学习”范式，将新知识写入4位量化权重中被丢弃的间隔，从而不改变原始存储位。CellFill通过在单元内构建低秩位置实现此范式。实验表明，CellFill成功将83%至97%的新事实注入到各种语言模型中，证明了其可用性，在特定任务上优于检索方法，并允许灵活的共享和顺序更新，而无需更改基础模型。
AI.keywords: 单元内学习, 语言模型, 知识注入, 4位量化, 模型更新
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于利用了量化过程中“丢弃”的间隔来注入新知识，从而实现了无需修改基础模型文件即可进行就地更新。这对于在部署系统中维护模型完整性和兼容性至关重要，有效解决了实际部署中的一个难题。

title: ForeDreamer: A Self-Evolving Dual-Agent Memory Architecture for Future Event Prediction
summary: Open-web future event prediction requires agents to distill reliable signals from noisy, redundant, and incomplete evidence. Existing retrieval/memory mechanisms directly feed retrieved information to agents or rely on simple memory functions such as storing and reusing prior information for prediction, leaving them insufficient for open-web forecasting. We propose to transform raw web evidence into structured memory before prediction, enabling agents to reason over distilled, question-specific evidence rather than noisy retrieval results. This paper presents ForeDreamer, a self-evolving dual-agent framework for managing memory over open-web evidence. ForeDreamer separates factual memory, a question-specific evidence state for the current forecast, from experiential memory, persistent agent experience accumulated across forecasting episodes. It uses a main agent for search and prediction, and a memory-processing subagent to convert search results into factual memory with dedicated tools. ForeDreamer further evolves experiential memory through two tracks, improving both forecasting decisions and factual-memory construction. Experiments on Prophet Arena and FutureX demonstrate the effectiveness of ForeDreamer. Project page: https://zhongzero.github.io/ForeDreamer

AI.title_translation: ForeDreamer：一种用于未来事件预测的自进化双智能体记忆架构
AI.tldr: ForeDreamer是一种自进化的双智能体框架，通过将原始网络证据转化为结构化记忆，并结合事实记忆和经验记忆，提高了开放网络未来事件预测的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的检索/记忆机制直接将检索到的信息提供给智能体，或依赖简单的记忆功能，这对于开放网络预测不足以从嘈杂、冗余和不完整的证据中提炼出可靠的信号。
AI.method: ForeDreamer是一个自进化的双智能体框架，用于管理开放网络证据的记忆。它将事实记忆（当前预测的特定问题证据状态）与经验记忆（跨预测事件积累的持久智能体经验）分开。它使用一个主智能体进行搜索和预测，一个记忆处理子智能体使用专用工具将搜索结果转换为事实记忆。ForeDreamer通过两条路径进一步进化经验记忆，改进预测决策和事实记忆构建。
AI.result: 在Prophet Arena和FutureX上的实验证明了ForeDreamer的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.translation: 开放网络未来事件预测需要智能体从嘈杂、冗余和不完整的证据中提炼出可靠的信号。现有的检索/记忆机制直接将检索到的信息提供给智能体，或依赖简单的记忆功能，例如存储和重用先验信息进行预测，这使得它们不足以进行开放网络预测。我们建议在预测之前将原始网络证据转化为结构化记忆，使智能体能够对提炼出的、特定问题证据进行推理，而不是嘈杂的检索结果。本文提出了ForeDreamer，一个用于管理开放网络证据记忆的自进化双智能体框架。ForeDreamer将事实记忆（当前预测的特定问题证据状态）与经验记忆（跨预测事件积累的持久智能体经验）分开。它使用一个主智能体进行搜索和预测，一个记忆处理子智能体使用专用工具将搜索结果转换为事实记忆。ForeDreamer通过两条路径进一步进化经验记忆，改进预测决策和事实记忆构建。在Prophet Arena和FutureX上的实验证明了ForeDreamer的有效性。项目页面：https://zhongzero.github.io/ForeDreamer
AI.summary: ForeDreamer是一个用于开放网络未来事件预测的自进化双智能体框架。它通过将原始网络证据转化为结构化记忆来解决现有方法在处理嘈杂、冗余信息方面的不足。该框架包含一个主智能体负责搜索和预测，以及一个记忆处理子智能体负责构建事实记忆。ForeDreamer区分了特定问题的事实记忆和积累的经验记忆，并能通过两条路径进化经验记忆，以提高预测准确性和记忆构建效率。实验证明了其在未来事件预测任务上的有效性。
AI.keywords: 未来事件预测, 双智能体, 记忆架构, 自进化, 开放网络
AI.comments: ForeDreamer的创新之处在于其独特的双智能体记忆架构，特别是将事实记忆与经验记忆分离，并引入自进化机制来持续改进预测和记忆构建过程。这种方法有效解决了开放网络环境中证据的噪声和不完整性问题，对于提升未来事件预测的准确性和鲁棒性具有重要意义。

title: AT-ViT: Area-Targeted Multi-View Vision Transformer with Cross-Attention and Multi-Scale Patching for Plant Trait Recognition in Herbarium Images
summary: Automated plant traits recognition from herbarium images is essential for plant sciences, yet remains challenging because background elements (e.g., textual labels, mounting artifacts, and color charts) can introduce shortcut learning, leading models to rely on spurious non-plant cues rather than plant morphology. This bias degrades both generalization and interpretability. In this paper, we introduce AT-ViT, a dual-branch Vision Transformer that jointly encodes raw herbarium scans and their segmented-derived counterparts via a multi-scale, multi-view cross-attention fusion scheme. AT-ViT further incorporates a mask-guided patch weighting mechanism that amplifies plant-relevant regions and attenuates background-driven features. By learning from the original scans while being guided by segmentation masks through the mask-guided patch reweighting mechanism, the model is encouraged to focus on plant organs and learn plant-centric representations more effectively. Across multiple trait classification tasks (e.g., leaf base shape, thorns), AT-ViT delivers consistent accuracy gains, improves attention localization on plant regions, and exhibits increased robustness under synthetic background perturbations. Specifically, AT-ViT substantially improves spatial attention grounding, boosting plant-region alignment (Avg IoU_p: +15.66 to +18.03 pp) while reducing background overlap (Avg IoU_b: -27.92 to -31.02 pp) relative to CrossViT, and remains markedly more robust to background perturbations, outperforming ResNet101 by up to +32.32 accuracy points and CrossViT by up to +5.07 points under background-noise conditions.

AI.title_translation: AT-ViT：用于植物标本图像植物性状识别的区域定向多视图视觉Transformer，具有交叉注意力和多尺度分块
AI.tldr: AT-ViT是一种双分支视觉Transformer，通过多尺度、多视图交叉注意力融合和掩码引导的补丁加权机制，解决了植物标本图像中背景元素导致的植物性状识别挑战，显著提高了准确性、注意力定位和对背景扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 植物标本图像的自动化植物性状识别对于植物科学至关重要，但由于背景元素（如文本标签、装裱痕迹和色卡）引入的捷径学习，导致模型依赖虚假的非植物线索而非植物形态，从而降低泛化性和可解释性，这仍然是一个挑战。
AI.method: 本文引入了AT-ViT，这是一种双分支视觉Transformer，通过多尺度、多视图交叉注意力融合方案共同编码原始植物标本扫描及其分割衍生的对应物。AT-ViT进一步结合了掩码引导的补丁加权机制，以放大与植物相关的区域并衰减背景驱动的特征，通过分割掩码引导模型关注植物器官并更有效地学习以植物为中心的表示。
AI.result: 在多个性状分类任务（例如，叶基形状、荆棘）中，AT-ViT提供了持续的准确性增益，改善了植物区域的注意力定位，并表现出在合成背景扰动下更高的鲁棒性。具体来说，AT-ViT显著改善了空间注意力接地，相对于CrossViT，植物区域对齐（平均IoU_p：+15.66至+18.03 pp）提高了，同时背景重叠（平均IoU_b：-27.92至-31.02 pp）减少了，并且在背景噪声条件下对背景扰动表现出明显更强的鲁棒性，比ResNet101高出+32.32的准确率点，比CrossViT高出+5.07点。
AI.conclusion: AT-ViT通过其创新的双分支、多视图交叉注意力融合和掩码引导的补丁加权机制，有效解决了植物标本图像中背景干扰导致的植物性状识别挑战，显著提升了模型的性能、可解释性和鲁棒性，使其能够更有效地学习以植物为中心的表示。
AI.translation: 从植物标本图像中自动识别植物性状对植物科学至关重要，但仍然具有挑战性，因为背景元素（例如，文本标签、装裱痕迹和色卡）可能引入捷径学习，导致模型依赖虚假的非植物线索而非植物形态。这种偏差会降低泛化性和可解释性。在本文中，我们引入了AT-ViT，这是一种双分支视觉Transformer，通过多尺度、多视图交叉注意力融合方案共同编码原始植物标本扫描及其分割衍生的对应物。AT-ViT进一步结合了掩码引导的补丁加权机制，以放大与植物相关的区域并衰减背景驱动的特征。通过从原始扫描中学习，并通过掩码引导的补丁重新加权机制由分割掩码引导，模型被鼓励专注于植物器官并更有效地学习以植物为中心的表示。在多个性状分类任务（例如，叶基形状、荆棘）中，AT-ViT提供了持续的准确性增益，改善了植物区域的注意力定位，并表现出在合成背景扰动下更高的鲁棒性。具体来说，AT-ViT显著改善了空间注意力接地，相对于CrossViT，植物区域对齐（平均IoU_p：+15.66至+18.03 pp）提高了，同时背景重叠（平均IoU_b：-27.92至-31.02 pp）减少了，并且在背景噪声条件下对背景扰动表现出明显更强的鲁棒性，比ResNet101高出+32.32的准确率点，比CrossViT高出+5.07点。
AI.summary: 本研究提出AT-ViT，一种双分支视觉Transformer，用于解决植物标本图像中背景干扰导致的植物性状识别难题。AT-ViT通过多尺度、多视图交叉注意力融合，并结合掩码引导的补丁加权机制，使模型能够同时从原始图像和分割掩码中学习，并专注于植物相关区域。实验结果表明，AT-ViT在多项性状分类任务中取得了显著的准确性提升，改善了注意力定位，并增强了在背景扰动下的鲁棒性，有效减少了背景对模型学习的负面影响。
AI.keywords: 植物性状识别, 视觉Transformer, 交叉注意力, 多尺度分块, 植物标本图像
AI.comments: AT-ViT的创新之处在于其双分支架构结合多尺度、多视图交叉注意力融合，以及独特的掩码引导的补丁加权机制。这种方法有效地解决了植物标本图像中背景元素引入的捷径学习问题，使模型能够更准确地关注植物形态而非背景噪声。这对于提高植物性状识别的泛化性和可解释性具有重要意义。

title: Atom Learning Model (ALM): how a real classroom got tokenised
comments: 25 pages, 13 figures. Companion data: https://github.com/philippbogdan/atom-learning-model. Interactive view of the catalogue: https://philippbogdan.com/atoms
summary: The Atom Learning Model (ALM) tokenises a school curriculum. Two secondary mathematics textbooks were read by machine into 1,934 atoms, each one thing a learner can do in a single step, ordered by 4,616 machine-written prerequisite links. Both sides of a lesson are then expressed in that one structure: a question is a set of atoms plus everything beneath them, a child's ability is a score between 0 and 1 on every atom of the same graph, and whether a question suits a child is arithmetic over one index, with no difficulty parameter fitted for either side. Nobody wrote an atom, a link or a question. Reading the 757 pages cost £55, building the whole structure cost between £615 and £1,230, and against it the system composed 6,648 questions for 373 children in two English secondary schools over seven weeks, at 26p per composed question. Four measurements went against expectation. The cost is in the links, not the pages. The composer's own difficulty label has a rank correlation of -0.0123 with measured facility, so a language model shown a question cannot say how hard it is. Children stop working when a mark takes seven seconds instead of three. And the deployment never served a question deeper than two prerequisite steps, which is exactly where the central premise becomes testable, leaving it unfalsified rather than confirmed.
comment: 25 pages, 13 figures. Companion data: https://github.com/philippbogdan/atom-learning-model. Interactive view of the catalogue: https://philippbogdan.com/atoms

AI.title_translation: 原子学习模型（ALM）：真实课堂如何被代币化
AI.tldr: ALM将课程内容分解为原子和先决条件链接，通过机器生成问题并评估学生能力，但部署结果显示了一些意外发现，且核心前提未被充分验证。
AI.motivation: 通过将学校课程代币化为离散的、机器可读的“原子”和先决条件链接，以创建一个结构化的学习模型（ALM），用于自动化问题生成和学生能力评估。
AI.method: 原子学习模型（ALM）将中学数学教科书代币化为1,934个“原子”（单一学习步骤）和4,616个机器编写的先决条件链接。这种结构定义了课程、问题（原子集合）和孩子的能力（每个原子0到1之间的分数）。问题通过算术组合，不涉及难度参数。该系统在两所中学为373名儿童生成了6,648个问题。
AI.result: 四项测量结果出乎意料：成本主要在于链接而非页面；问题生成器自身的难度标签与实际易用性等级相关性为-0.0123；当标记时间从三秒增加到七秒时，孩子们会停止工作；部署从未提供超过两个先决条件步骤的问题，导致核心前提未被证伪而非被证实。
AI.conclusion: ALM成功地将课程代币化并生成了问题，但由于部署限制，其关于更深层先决条件步骤的核心前提仍未得到验证。成本结构和难度评估方法也揭示了一些意想不到的发现。
AI.translation: 原子学习模型（ALM）将学校课程代币化。机器读取了两本中学数学教科书，将其分解为1,934个“原子”，每个原子代表学习者可以一步完成的一件事，并通过4,616个机器编写的先决条件链接进行排序。课程的两个方面都以这种单一结构表达：一个问题是一组原子加上它们之下的所有内容，一个孩子的能力是同一图谱上每个原子的0到1之间的分数，以及一个问题是否适合一个孩子是通过一个索引进行的算术运算，双方都没有拟合难度参数。没有人编写原子、链接或问题。读取757页的成本为55英镑，构建整个结构的成本在615至1,230英镑之间，在此基础上，该系统在七周内为两所英格兰中学的373名儿童生成了6,648个问题，每个生成问题成本为26便士。四项测量结果出乎意料。成本在于链接，而非页面。作曲家自身的难度标签与测得的易用性等级相关性为-0.0123，因此向语言模型展示一个问题无法说明其难度。当标记需要七秒而不是三秒时，孩子们会停止工作。并且部署从未提供超过两个先决条件步骤的问题，这正是核心前提变得可测试的地方，因此它未被证伪而非被证实。
AI.summary: 原子学习模型（ALM）是一种新颖的课程代币化方法，将中学数学教科书转换为“原子”（单步学习单元）和机器生成的先决条件链接。这种结构允许自动化问题组合和学生能力评估，无需人工分配难度参数。尽管在创建和问题生成方面具有成本效益，但部署揭示了意想不到的发现：成本负担在于链接而非页面；机器分配的难度与实际易用性无关；部署中的一个关键限制阻止了对模型关于更深层先决条件步骤的核心前提进行测试。
AI.keywords: 原子学习模型, 课程代币化, 教育技术, 自适应学习, 机器生成内容
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种创新且高度自动化的课程结构化和自适应学习方法。其优势在于机器生成的内容（原子、链接、问题）以及无需人工拟合难度参数，旨在实现可扩展性和客观性。然而，部署未能测试关于更深层先决条件步骤的核心前提是一个重大限制，导致模型的全部潜力和有效性未得到证实。关于成本分布和机器分配难度标签不可靠的发现，对未来人工智能驱动的教育发展至关重要。

title: BackDFL: A Unified Benchmark For Backdoor Attacks and Defenses In Decentralized Federated Learning
comments: Accepted for presentation at the ANUBIS Workshop, co-located with ESORICS'26
summary: Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) promises trust-free collaborative learning by replacing the centralized parameter server with peer-to-peer model exchange. However, this architectural shift fundamentally reshapes the threat landscape. Without globally coordinated aggregation, DFL becomes particularly susceptible to backdoor attacks, in which malicious participants implant persistent hidden behaviors while maintaining high clean-task performance. In this paper, we argue that the robustness of DFL has been significantly overestimated. Existing studies rely on simplified threat models, non-adaptive adversaries, fragmented evaluation protocols, inconsistent communication topologies, and ad hoc training configurations, leading to an incomplete understanding of DFL security. To address these limitations, we present BackDFL, a unified benchmark for systematically evaluating DFL under realistic and adaptive backdoor attacks. Through extensive experiments, BackDFL exposes critical failure modes of decentralized learning. Our results demonstrate that both state-of-the-art Byzantine-robust DFL methods and adapted FL backdoor defenses fail under modest malicious participation rates (as low as 15%), especially in heterogeneous settings, while their robustness varies substantially across communication graph topologies.
comment: Accepted for presentation at the ANUBIS Workshop, co-located with ESORICS'26

AI.title_translation: BackDFL：去中心化联邦学习中后门攻击与防御的统一基准
AI.tldr: 论文提出了 BackDFL，一个用于去中心化联邦学习（DFL）后门攻击和防御的统一基准，并证明了现有 DFL 防御方法在真实、自适应的攻击下极易失效。
AI.motivation: 现有的去中心化联邦学习（DFL）研究依赖于简化的威胁模型、非自适应的对立者、分散的评估协议、不一致的通信拓扑和临时的训练配置，导致对其安全性的理解不完整，且其鲁棒性被大大高估。
AI.method: 提出了 BackDFL（一个用于去中心化联邦学习中后门攻击和防御的统一基准），通过广泛的实验在各种威胁模型、自适应攻击、通信图拓扑和异构设置下评估了去中心化学习的安全性。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有的最先进的拜占庭鲁棒 DFL 方法和适应性的联邦学习后门防御在较低的恶意参与率（低至15%）下失效，特别是在异构设置中，且其鲁棒性在不同的通信图拓扑结构下差异巨大。
AI.conclusion: BackDFL 作为一个统一的基准测试，表明现有的 DFL 防御方法在面对现实且自适应的后门攻击时极其脆弱，强调了在真实多变的网络和异构环境下重新评估 DFL 安全性的必要性。
AI.translation: 去中心化联邦学习（DFL）通过用点对点模型交换取代中心化参数服务器，承诺实现免信任的协作学习。然而，这种架构转变从根本上重塑了威胁格局。没有全局协调的聚合，DFL 变得特别容易受到后门攻击的影响，在这种攻击中，恶意参与者在保持高干净任务性能的同时植入持久的隐藏行为。在本文中，我们认为 DFL 的鲁棒性被严重高估了。现有研究依赖于简化的威胁模型、非自适应的对抗者、碎片化的评估协议、不一致的通信拓扑以及特设的训练配置，导致对 DFL 安全性的理解不完整。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 BackDFL，这是一个在现实且自适应的后门攻击下系统评估 DFL 的统一基准。通过广泛的实验，BackDFL 暴露了去中心化学习的严重失效模式。我们的结果表明，无论是最先进的拜占庭鲁棒 DFL 方法还是适应后的联邦学习后门防御，在适度的恶意参与率（低至15%）下都无法奏效，尤其是在异构环境中，而它们的鲁棒性在不同的通信图拓扑之间差异显著。
AI.summary: 该论文指出了去中心化联邦学习（DFL）在面对后门攻击时安全性的严重高估，并推出了 BackDFL —— 一个用于系统评估 DFL 中后门攻击和防御的统一基准。广泛的实验揭示了现有防御方法在自适应攻击、异构环境及不同通信拓扑下的失效模式。
AI.keywords: 去中心化联邦学习, 后门攻击, 鲁棒性, 基准测试, 对抗性机器学习
AI.comments: 该论文指出了去中心化联邦学习（DFL）在后门攻击下面临的严重安全威胁，并指出现有研究的局限性。通过提出统一的基准测试 BackDFL，揭示了现有防御机制在自适应攻击和异构环境下的脆弱性，对该领域的研究具有重要的推动作用。

title: On the Time and Frequency Domain Representations of Signals for CPS Specification
summary: Specification languages are instrumental to the Verification \& Validation of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs). Most state-of-the-art specification languages use the time-domain representation of signals, which is not always suitable for describing signal shapes and dynamic behaviours. Instead, fields like control and robotics use the frequency-domain representation to characterise these behaviours. Time-frequency representations combine the capabilities of both domains. We investigate the use of time-frequency representations to specify CPS requirements. We analyse existing taxonomies of CPS requirements to identify which requirement classes can benefit from time-frequency representations. We derive the desiderata for a specification language that uses time-frequency representations and propose Signal-Spectrum Temporal Logic (S2TL), a language enabling assertions over frequency intervals and relations between frequency components. We operationalise the S2TL semantics for monitoring CPS traces, and implement a monitor. We define specification templates for the identified requirement classes and compare time- and time-frequency-domain formulations in terms of applicability, expression fidelity, and noise tolerance of monitoring. We observe that, while time-domain specifications are applicable only to input traces containing step-like changes or using constant interpolation, time-frequency specifications extend their evaluation to traces generated through linear interpolation, and improve tolerance to offset and high-frequency noise, while achieving comparable fidelity to the intended system properties.

AI.title_translation: 论用于CPS规范的信号时域与频域表示
AI.tldr: 本文提出了信号谱时序逻辑（S2TL），首次将时频域表示引入CPS规范，显著提高了系统对噪声的容忍度和对不同信号插值的适应性。
AI.motivation: 大多数最先进的CPS规范语言使用时域信号表示，这并不总是适合描述信号形状和动态行为，而控制和机器人等领域常使用频域或时频域来表征这些行为。
AI.method: 分析CPS需求分类以确定适用时频表示的类别；推导时频规范语言的要求；提出信号谱时序逻辑（S2TL），支持频域断言；实现S2TL的监测器；定义规范模板并对比时域与时频域表述。
AI.result: 时频规范将评估扩展到了线性插值生成的轨迹，提高了对偏移和高频噪声的容忍度，同时在系统属性表达上达到了与时域相当的保真度。
AI.conclusion: 时频域表示（如S2TL）能显著扩展CPS规范语言的表达能力、提高对噪声的容忍度并支持更多类型的信号插值，是传统时域规范的重要补充。
AI.translation: 规范语言对于信息物理系统（CPS）的验证与确认（V&V）起着至关重要的作用。大多数最先进的规范语言使用信号的时域表示，这并不总是适合描述信号形状和动态行为。相反，控制和机器人等领域使用频域表示来表征这些行为。时-频表示结合了两个域的能力。我们研究了使用时-频表示来规范CPS需求的方法。我们分析了现有的CPS需求分类法，以确定哪些需求类别可以从时-频表示中受益。我们推导了使用时-频表示的规范语言的需求，并提出了信号谱时序逻辑（S2TL），这是一种能够对频率区间以及频率分量之间的关系进行断言的语言。我们使S2TL语义可操作化以监测CPS轨迹，并实现了一个监测器。我们为已识别的需求类别定义了规范模板，并在适用性、表达保真度和监测噪声容忍度方面比较了时域和时-频域表述。我们观察到，虽然时域规范仅适用于包含阶跃式变化或使用常数插值的输入轨迹，但时-频规范将其评估扩展到了通过线性插值生成的轨迹，并提高了对偏移和高频噪声的容忍度，同时实现了与预期系统属性相当的保真度。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了时频域表示在CPS需求规范中的应用，分析了现有分类，提出了“信号谱时序逻辑（S2TL）”语言，实现了监测器，并通过对比证明了时频规范在插值适应性和抗噪能力方面的优势。
AI.keywords: Cyber-Physical Systems, Specification Languages, Time-Frequency Representation, Temporal Logic, Signal-Spectrum Temporal Logic
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将时频域表示引入CPS规范语言中，提出了S2TL，有效解决了传统时域规范在处理动态行为、噪声容忍度以及插值方式上的局限性。

title: Mining Artifacts in Mycelium SEM Micrographs
summary:
Mycelium is a promising biomaterial based on fungal mycelium, a highly porous, nanofibrous structure. Scanning electron micrographs are used to characterize its network, but the currently available tools for nanofibrous microstructures do not contemplate the particularities of biomaterials. The adoption of a software for artificial nanofibrous in mycelium characterization adds the uncertainty of imaging artifact formation to the analysis. The reported work combines supervised and unsupervised machine learning methods to automate the identification of artifacts in the mapped pores of mycelium microstructure.
  Keywords: Machine learning; unsupervised learning; image processing; mycelium; microstructure informatics

AI.title_translation: 菌丝体SEM显微图像中的伪影挖掘
AI.tldr: 本研究结合监督与无监督机器学习，实现了菌丝体SEM显微图像中微观孔隙伪影的自动化识别。
AI.motivation: 现有的纳米纤维微结构分析工具没有考虑到生物材料的独特性，采用人工纳米纤维软件会导致成像伪影形成的不确定性，因此需要一种自动化的方法来识别这些伪影。
AI.method: 结合了监督和无监督机器学习方法，用于自动化识别菌丝体微结构映射孔隙中的伪影。
AI.result: 成功开发了结合监督与无监督机器学习的方法，实现了菌丝体微观结构映射孔隙中伪影的自动化识别。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合监督和无监督机器学习方法，可以有效实现菌丝体SEM显微图像中孔隙伪影的自动化识别，从而提高生物材料微观结构表征的可靠性。
AI.translation: 菌丝体是一种基于真菌菌丝的有前景的生物材料，具有高度多孔的纳米纤维结构。扫描电子显微镜（SEM）被用于表征其网络结构，但目前可用的纳米纤维微结构工具并未考虑到生物材料的独特性质。在菌丝体表征中采用人工纳米纤维软件会给分析带来成像伪影形成的不确定性。本研究结合了监督和无监督机器学习方法，实现了对菌丝体微结构映射孔隙中伪影识别的自动化。
AI.summary: 该论文针对真菌菌丝体这一新兴纳米纤维生物材料在扫描电子显微镜（SEM）图像表征中缺乏专用工具的问题，提出了一种结合监督与无监督机器学习的方法，用于自动化识别和处理映射孔隙中的成像伪影，从而提高材料微结构分析的准确性。
AI.keywords: Machine learning, unsupervised learning, image processing, mycelium, microstructure informatics
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地结合了监督与无监督机器学习方法，专门针对真菌菌丝体这类具有特殊微观结构的新兴生物材料，解决了现有纳米纤维分析软件在处理生物材料时易产生成像伪影的不确定性问题，对提升生物材料微结构表征的准确性具有重要意义。

title: Machine Learning Classification and Portfolio Construction: Does the Loss Function Matter?
summary: Classification outperforms regression across matched machine learning models in portfolio construction. A stacking ensemble of gradient boosted tree, random forest, and neural network yields a value-weighted annualized Sharpe ratio of 1.83 for classification and 1.11 for regression. This outperformance persists in multiclass settings, across subsamples, and after transaction costs. Spanning tests show that classification retains economically large alphas after we control for regression, whereas regression alphas shrink substantially once we control for classification. These results indicate that classification extracts more return information than matched regression. Our diagnostics trace classification's advantage to sharper and more precise separation of return deciles.

AI.title_translation: 机器学习分类与投资组合构建：损失函数重要吗？
AI.tldr: 在投资组合构建中，机器学习的分类方法明显优于回归方法，能带来更高的夏普比率和更强的收益预测能力。
AI.motivation: 探究在投资组合构建中，使用分类方法的机器学习模型是否比回归方法表现更好，以及损失函数的选择对模型性能和投资回报的影响。
AI.method: 对比了匹配的机器学习模型（包括梯度提升树、随机森林和神经网络构成的堆叠集成）在分类和回归设置下的表现，并进行了跨子样本测试、交易成本调整和跨越测试（spanning tests）。
AI.result: 分类模型的年化夏普比率为1.83，显著高于回归模型的1.11；分类模型在多分类、不同子样本以及考虑交易成本后依然保持优势，且能产生经济意义上显著的阿尔法。
AI.conclusion: 在投资组合构建中，机器学习分类方法明显优于回归方法，分类模型能更准确地分离收益十分位数并提取更多的收益信息。
AI.translation: 在匹配的机器学习模型中，分类在投资组合构建中的表现优于回归。由梯度提升树、随机森林和神经网络组成的堆叠集成模型，其价值加权年化夏普比率在分类下达到1.83，而在回归下为1.11。这种优越性在多分类设置、各个子样本中以及扣除交易成本后依然存在。跨越测试表明，在控制了回归方法后，分类方法依然保留了经济意义上巨大的阿尔法，而回归的阿尔法在控制了分类方法后大幅缩水。这些结果表明，分类比匹配的回归提取了更多的收益信息。我们的诊断表明，分类的优势归功于对收益十分位数更敏锐、更精确的分离。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了机器学习在投资组合构建中损失函数（分类与回归）的选择影响。研究发现，分类模型的表现显著优于回归模型，能带来更高的夏普比率和阿尔法，其核心原因在于分类能更清晰、更精确地分离收益十分位数。
AI.keywords: 机器学习, 投资组合构建, 分类与回归, 损失函数, 夏普比率
AI.comments: 该论文指出了机器学习在投资组合构建中选择分类方法而非回归方法的重要性，通过实验证明了分类模型在提取收益信息和提供更高夏普比率方面的明显优势，对量化投资具有重要的指导意义。

title: Is Decentralized Finance Actually Decentralized? An Interdisciplinary Framework Integrating Network Theory, Agent-Based Simulation, and Longitudinal Evidence from Aave, GHO Issuance, and Cross-Chain Expansion
summary: Decentralized finance (DeFi) can broaden access while leaving activity, network position, and infrastructure concentrated. We develop a four-dimensional framework for participation, activity distribution, structural position, and infrastructure dependence, integrating network theory, theorem-consistent agent-based simulation, and longitudinal analysis of 1,956,216 Aave V3 Pool events. We study GHO issuance on Ethereum (15 July 2023) and its first cross-chain expansion to Aave's existing Arbitrum market (2 July 2024). Excluding each activation week, mean weekly active position-holder addresses increased by 91.0% around Ethereum issuance and 1.7% around Arbitrum expansion, while activity concentration fell by 31.5% on Ethereum but rose by 58.1% on Arbitrum. On a common 2024 calendar, the Arbitrum--Gnosis DiD-style change is +1.9833 for log participation and -0.01842 for position-holder-event HHI. Rule-based simulations recover the analytical equilibrium and show why aggregate growth can coexist with lower, unchanged, or higher concentration, while chain dispersion alone cannot establish route or shared-component resilience. Role-aware analysis further shows that network-structure conclusions vary by protocol action and scale. Intellectually, the framework explains why four dimensions of decentralization can diverge. Practically, it helps researchers, protocol designers, governance communities, and policymakers assess stablecoin growth without equating adoption with decentralization.

AI.title_translation: 去中心化金融真的去中心化吗？一个整合了网络理论、基于主体模拟以及Aave、GHO发行和跨链扩张纵向证据的跨学科框架
AI.tldr: 通过构建四维分析框架并对Aave及GHO进行纵向实证研究，论文发现DeFi的采用率增长并不等同于去中心化程度的提高，多维度去中心化指标常常出现背离。
AI.motivation: 尽管去中心化金融（DeFi）旨在扩大金融准入，但其活动、网络地位和基础设施往往仍然高度集中。为了澄清“DeFi是否真正去中心化”这一问题，需要一个能够解释多维度去中心化指标可能发生背离的综合分析框架。
AI.method: 开发了一个包含参与度、活动分布、结构位置和基础设施依赖的四维评估框架，整合了网络理论、定理一致的基于主体模拟（agent-based simulation）以及对1,956,216个Aave V3池事件的纵向分析，并运用了双重差分（DiD）风格的变化分析。
AI.result: 实证分析显示，在GHO发行和跨链扩张期间，平均每周活跃地址数有所增长，但活动集中度在不同链上表现各异（Ethereum下降31.5%，Arbitrum上升58.1%）。模拟结果表明，聚合增长可以与不同水平的集中度共存，且链分散本身无法保证路由或共享组件的复原力。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化金融（DeFi）的聚合增长并不必然意味着去中心化程度的提高；参与度、活动分布、结构位置和基础设施依赖这四个维度经常出现背离。评估DeFi的复原力需要多维度的综合考量，而不能仅依赖链分散性或采用率。
AI.translation: 去中心化金融（DeFi）在扩大准入的同时，可能会使活动、网络地位和基础设施趋于集中。我们开发了一个包含参与度、活动分布、结构位置和基础设施依赖的四维框架，整合了网络理论、定理一致的基于主体模拟，以及对1,956,216个Aave V3池事件的纵向分析。我们研究了以太坊上的GHO发行（2023年7月15日）及其向Aave现有Arbitrum市场的首次跨链扩展（2024年7月2日）。排除各自的激活周后，以太坊发行前后平均每周活跃持仓地址增加了91.0%，活动集中度下降了31.5%；而在Arbitrum扩展前后，活跃地址增加1.7%，活动集中度上升了58.1%。在共同的2024年日历下，Arbitrum与Gnosis的双重差分风格变化在对数参与度上为+1.9833，在持仓者事件HHI上为-0.01842。基于规则的模拟恢复了分析均衡，并展示了为什么总体增长可以与更低、不变或更高的集中度共存，同时单纯的链分散无法建立路由或共享组件的复原力。角色感知分析进一步表明，网络结构的结论随协议动作和规模而变化。在理论上，该框架解释了去中心化的四个维度为何会发生背离。在实践中，它帮助研究人员、协议设计者、治理社区和政策制定者评估稳定币的增长，而不会将采用等同于去中心化。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一个四维去中心化评估框架，结合网络理论、基于主体的模拟与Aave等协议的纵向数据，研究了DeFi的实际去中心化程度。研究发现，采用率的增长并不等同于去中心化的提升，四个维度的去中心化常常会相互背离。
AI.keywords: 去中心化金融, 网络理论, 基于主体的模拟, 纵向分析, Aave
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地构建了一个结合网络理论、基于主体的模拟和纵向实证分析的四维去中心化评估框架，深入剖析了DeFi（以Aave及其GHO稳定币为例）在扩张过程中的去中心化真实水平，挑战了“采用即去中心化”的传统迷思，对未来区块链治理与政策制定具有重要指导意义。

title: Neuro-Causal Factor Analysis
comments: 30 pages, 8 figures; accepted to The 13th International Conference on Probabilistic Graphical Models (PGM)
summary: Factor analysis (FA) is a statistical method for explaining how mutually dependent observed variables can be represented in terms of mutually independent latent factors, and it is widely used in the psychological, biological, and physical sciences. We revisit this classic method from the perspective of recent advances in causal structure learning and deep generative models, introducing a framework for Neuro-Causal Factor Analysis (NCFA). Our approach is fully nonparametric: it learns a directed graph between latent and observed variables, and then fits a deep generative model constrained to respect the Markov factorization of the graph. Empirically, on synthetic and real data, NCFA attains better reconstruction error compared to standard FA and better latent distribution recovery compared to a standard variational autoencoder, all with the advantages of sparser architecture, lower model complexity, and causal interpretability.
comment: 30 pages, 8 figures; accepted to The 13th International Conference on Probabilistic Graphical Models (PGM)

AI.title_translation: 神经因果因子分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种神经因果因子分析（NCFA）框架，通过结合因果结构学习和深度生成模型，实现了更好的重构误差、潜变量恢复以及因果可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统的因子分析虽然应用广泛，但结合了近期因果结构学习和深度生成模型的最新进展进行改进的空间很大，需要一种能够提供因果可解释性且具有较低模型复杂度的非参数方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为神经因果因子分析（NCFA）的完全非参数框架：首先学习潜变量与观测变量之间的有向图，然后拟合一个受该图马尔可夫分解约束的深度生成模型。
AI.result: 在合成数据和真实数据上的实验表明，与标准因子分析相比，NCFA获得了更好的重构误差；与标准变分自编码器相比，获得了更好的潜变量恢复效果，同时具备更稀疏的架构、更低的模型复杂度和因果可解释性。
AI.conclusion: NCFA框架成功将因果结构学习引入传统因子分析中，在保证因果可解释性的同时，提升了模型的重构能力和潜变量恢复性能。
AI.translation: 因子分析（FA）是一种统计方法，用于解释相互依赖的观测变量如何用相互独立的潜变量来表示，它广泛应用于心理学、生物学和物理学中。我们从近期因果结构学习和深度生成模型的进展角度重新审视了这一经典方法，引入了一种神经因果因子分析（NCFA）框架。我们的方法是完全非参数的：它学习潜变量和观测变量之间的有向图，然后拟合一个受该图马尔可夫分解约束的深度生成模型。在实证方面，在合成数据和真实数据上，NCFA与标准FA相比获得了更好的重构误差，与标准变分自编码器相比获得了更好的潜变量恢复效果，同时具备更稀疏的架构、更低的模型复杂度和因果可解释性。
AI.summary: 该论文重新审视了传统的因子分析方法，引入了神经因果因子分析（NCFA）框架。该非参数方法通过结合因果结构学习和深度生成模型，学习变量间的有向图并拟合相应的生成模型，在合成与真实数据集上实现了更优的重构误差、潜变量恢复及因果可解释性。
AI.keywords: 因子分析, 因果结构学习, 深度生成模型, 潜变量, 非参数模型
AI.comments: 该论文结合了因果结构学习和深度生成模型，提出了一种非参数的神经因果因子分析方法（NCFA），在重构误差、潜变量恢复以及可解释性方面展现出优势。

title: Deep Clustering Evaluation: How to Validate Internal Clustering Validation Measures
summary: Deep clustering partitions complex high-dimensional data using deep neural networks for clustering. It involves projecting data into lower-dimensional embeddings before partitioning, which embarks unique evaluation challenges. Traditional clustering validation measures, designed for low-dimensional spaces, are problematic for deep clustering for two reasons: 1) the curse of dimensionality when applied to the high-dimensional input data, and 2) unreliable comparison of clustering results when applied to embedded data from different embedding spaces, owing to variations in training procedures and model parameter settings. This paper addresses these unresolved and often overlooked challenges in evaluating clustering within deep learning. We propose a systematic evaluation framework for internal clustering validation measures that: (1) theoretically establishes why traditional measures are ineffective when applied to input data or across disparate embedding spaces paired with partitioning outcomes; (2) identifies embedding spaces that endorse reliable evaluations by detecting groups with high agreement in ranking partitioning outcomes; and (3) develops a stable and robust scoring scheme by weighting index values computed across these identified embedding spaces. Experiments show that this new framework aligns better with external measures, effectively reducing the misguidance from the improper use of internal validation measures in deep clustering evaluation.

AI.title_translation: 深度聚类评估：如何验证内部聚类验证指标
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对深度聚类中内部验证指标的系统化评估框架，解决了传统指标因维度灾难和跨嵌入空间不可比而失效的问题。
AI.motivation: 深度聚类在处理复杂高-dimensional数据时面临独特的评估挑战，传统的内部聚类验证指标由于维度灾难以及应用在不同嵌入空间时缺乏可比性，在深度聚类中表现出问题，本文旨在解决这些未得到解决且经常被忽视的评估挑战。
AI.method: 提出一个系统化的评估框架，包括：1) 理论证明传统指标在输入数据或不同嵌入空间中失效的原因；2) 通过检测对划分结果排序具有高度一致性的组来识别支持可靠评估的嵌入空间；3) 通过对这些嵌入空间计算出的指标值进行加权，开发出稳定且鲁棒的评分方案。
AI.result: 实验表明，该新框架与外部指标具有更好的对齐性，有效地减少了深度聚类评估中因不当使用内部验证指标而产生的误导。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的系统化评估框架通过理论证明、可靠嵌入空间识别及加权评分方案，有效解决了深度聚类中内部验证指标失效的问题，实验证明其能更好地与外部指标对齐。
AI.translation: 深度聚类使用深度神经网络对复杂的高维数据进行聚类划分。它涉及在划分之前将数据投影到低维嵌入中，这带来了独特的评估挑战。专为低维空间设计的传统聚类验证指标对于深度聚类来说是有问题的，原因有二：1）当应用于高维输入数据时的维数灾难，以及2）由于训练过程和模型参数设置的变化，当应用于来自不同嵌入空间的嵌入数据时，聚类结果的比较不可靠。本文解决了深度学习聚类评估中这些未解决且经常被忽视的挑战。我们为内部聚类验证指标提出了一个系统评估框架，该框架：（1）从理论上阐明了为什么传统指标在应用于输入数据或与划分结果配对的不同嵌入空间时无效；（2）通过检测对划分结果排序具有高度一致性的组，识别出支持可靠评估的嵌入空间；（3）通过对在这些识别出的嵌入空间计算出的指标值进行加权，开发了一个稳定且鲁棒的评分方案。实验表明，这个新框架与外部指标更好地对齐，有效地减少了深度聚类评估中不当使用内部验证指标带来的误导。
AI.summary: 本文针对深度聚类中内部聚类验证指标面临的“维数灾难”与跨嵌入空间不可比的挑战，提出了一种系统化的评估框架。该框架通过理论分析、可靠嵌入空间识别及加权评分机制，显著提升了深度聚类评估的准确性与鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 深度聚类, 内部聚类验证, 高维数据, 嵌入空间, 评估框架
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地指出了传统内部聚类验证指标在深度聚类中应用的局限性，并提出了一套系统化的评估框架，对于规范和推动深度聚类算法的可靠评估具有重要意义。

title: Robust performance metrics for imbalanced classification problems
summary: We show that established performance metrics in binary classification, such as Matthews' correlation coefficient (MCC), Cohen's $κ$, the F-score or the Jaccard similarity coefficient are not robust to class imbalance in the sense that if the proportion of the minority class tends to $0$, the true positive rate (TPR) of the Bayes classifier under these metrics tends to $0$ as well. Thus, in imbalanced classification problems, these metrics favour classifiers which ignore the minority class. To alleviate this issue we introduce robustified modifications of the MCC, of Cohen's $κ$ and of the F-score with an additional tuning parameter which allows to adapt the amount of robustness against class imbalance. As theoretical guarantee we show that the Bayes-optimal classifier for these robustified performance metrics, when expressed in terms of the density ratio $f_1/f_0$ of the class-conditional densities $f_i$, has a threshold parameter which is upper-bounded in terms of the tuning parameters. Therefore, even in strongly imbalanced settings, the TPR associated to this classifier will be bounded away from $0$. We numerically illustrate the behaviour of the various performance metrics and the effect of the tuning parameters in simulations as well as on a credit default data set. We also discuss connections to the receiver operating characteristic and precision-recall curves, which provide an alternative perspective on the proposed notion of robustness, and give recommendations on how to combine their usage with performance metrics.

title: Cross-validating causal discovery via Leave-One-Variable-Out
summary:
We propose a new approach to falsify causal discovery algorithms without ground truth, which is based on testing the causal model on a variable pair excluded during learning the causal model. Specifically, given data on $X, Y, \boldsymbol{Z}=X, Y, Z_1,\dots,Z_k$, we apply the causal discovery algorithm separately to the 'leave-one-out' data sets $X, \boldsymbol{Z}$ and $Y, \boldsymbol{Z}$. We demonstrate that the two resulting causal models, in the form DAGs, ADMGs, CPDAGs or PAGs, often entail conclusions on the dependencies between $X$ and $Y$ and allow to estimate $\mathbb{E}(Y\mid X=x)$ without any joint observations of $X$ and $Y$, given only the leave-one-out datasets. This estimation is called "Leave-One-Variable-Out (LOVO)" prediction. Its error can be estimated since the joint distribution $P(X, Y)$ is available, and $X$ and $Y$ have only been omitted for the purpose of falsification.
  We present two variants of LOVO prediction: One graphical method, which is applicable to general causal discovery algorithms, and one version tailored towards algorithms relying on specific a priori assumptions, such as linear additive noise models. Simulations indicate that the LOVO prediction error is indeed correlated with the accuracy of the causal outputs, affirming the method's effectiveness.

title: Conditional regression for the Nonlinear Single-Variable Model
summary: Regressing a function $F$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$ without incurring the statistical and computational curse of dimensionality requires exploitable structure. Compositional models $F=f\circ g$ in which $g$ has a low-dimensional range include classical single- and multi-index models as well as certain neural networks; while the case of linear $g$ is well understood, substantially less is known for nonlinear $g$. We study the model $F(X)=f(Π_γX)$, where $Π_γ$ is the closest-point coordinate associated with an unknown regular curve $γ$, and $f$ is an unknown one-dimensional link function. The predictor $X$ need not be intrinsically low-dimensional and may have full-dimensional variation throughout a tubular neighborhood of the curve. We construct a nonparametric estimator based on response slicing, local principal component analysis, data-adaptive slice assignment, and one-dimensional local polynomial regression. Under coarse monotonicity of $f$ and sufficient variation normal to the curve relative to the observational noise and the coarse-monotonicity scale, the estimator attains, up to logarithmic factors, the minimax-optimal one-dimensional mean squared rate down to an explicit geometry- and noise-dependent saturation level. When the normal-variation condition is removed, we prove a complementary guarantee for the wide-slice regime. The estimator can be constructed in time $\mathcal{O}(d^2n\log n)$, and the constants and sample-size thresholds in our bounds depend at most polynomially on the ambient dimension $d$.

title: QuantFormer: Learning to Quantize for Neural Activity Forecasting in Mouse Visual Cortex
summary: Understanding complex animal behaviors hinges on deciphering the neural activity patterns within brain circuits, making the ability to forecast neural activity crucial for developing predictive models of brain dynamics. This capability holds immense value for neuroscience, particularly in applications such as real-time optogenetic interventions. While traditional encoding and decoding methods have been used to map external variables to neural activity and vice versa, they focus on interpreting past data. In contrast, neural forecasting aims to predict future neural activity, presenting a unique and challenging task due to the spatiotemporal sparsity and complex dependencies of neural signals. Existing transformer-based forecasting methods, while effective in many domains, struggle to capture the distinctiveness of neural signals characterized by spatiotemporal sparsity and intricate dependencies. To address this challenge, we here introduce QuantFormer, a transformer-based model specifically designed for forecasting neural activity from two-photon calcium imaging data. Unlike conventional regression-based approaches, QuantFormerreframes the forecasting task as a classification problem via dynamic signal quantization, enabling more effective learning of sparse neural activation patterns. Additionally, QuantFormer tackles the challenge of analyzing multivariate signals from an arbitrary number of neurons by incorporating neuron-specific tokens, allowing scalability across diverse neuronal populations. Trained with unsupervised quantization on the Allen dataset, QuantFormer sets a new benchmark in forecasting mouse visual cortex activity. It demonstrates robust performance and generalization across various stimuli and individuals, paving the way for a foundational model in neural signal prediction.

title: Semiparametric Double Reinforcement Learning with Applications to Long-Term Causal Inference
summary: Double reinforcement learning (DRL) provides efficient off-policy inference for policy values in nonparametric Markov decision processes (MDPs), but fully nonparametric estimators can be unstable when intertemporal overlap is weak and occupancy ratios are high-dimensional. This limitation is especially relevant for long-term causal inference from randomized experiments: randomization ensures overlap in treatment assignment, but not over future state trajectories induced by continued intervention use. We develop semiparametric DRL for continuous linear functionals of the infinite-horizon $Q$-function. Rather than impose linear MDP structure on the reward and transition laws, we place working semiparametric restrictions on the $Q$-function itself, the solution of the discounted Bellman equation. When correct, these restrictions can improve efficiency relative to unrestricted DRL while allowing rich, possibly infinite-dimensional models. To avoid relying on correct specification, we define the estimand through weighted Bellman-residual minimization. The resulting projection target remains meaningful under misspecification and recovers the original functional under correct specification. For this class of parameters, we derive efficient influence functions and efficiency bounds, construct model-robust automatically debiased estimators, and develop minimax criteria for estimating the $Q$- and Riesz functions. Under correct specification, optimally weighted versions attain the semiparametric efficiency bound in the restricted model.

title: Bringing Generative Learning to Representation Learning: Self-Supervised Transfer Learning as Distribution Matching
comments: 70 pages, 5 figures, and 6 tables. Substantially revised version with a new title, an explicit distribution-matching formulation linking generative learning and representation learning, expanded theoretical treatment, additional transfer experiments, and appendices integrated into the main file. Code is available at https://github.com/vincen-github/DM
summary: Most self-supervised learning objectives defend against collapse but leave the target representation law unspecified. We formulate representation learning as Distribution Matching (DM), learning an augmentation-invariant encoder whose induced law matches an explicit geometric reference. The reference law specifies what the learned representation distribution should look like, whereas a separately chosen discrepancy determines how deviations from this target are measured; here we use Mallows distance. The DM framework reveals a directional inverse: generative learning maps a tractable reference to data, whereas representation learning maps data to a designed reference law. We connect the population objective to class-centre separation and classification error and prove a non-asymptotic neural-sieve guarantee. Simulations and image benchmarks show manifold rectification, fine-grained structure and transfer across label spaces.

title: Stochastic block models with many communities and the Kesten--Stigum bound
comments: 47 pages, 1 figure, corrected proof of Theorem 1.2, other minor improvements, extended abstract in COLT 2025
summary:
We study the inference of communities in stochastic block models with a growing number of communities. For block models with $n$ vertices and a fixed number of communities $q$, it was predicted in Decelle et al. (2011) that there are computationally efficient algorithms for recovering the communities above the Kesten--Stigum (KS) bound and that efficient recovery is impossible below the KS bound. This conjecture has since stimulated a lot of interest, with the achievability side proven in a line of research that culminated in the work of Abbe and Sandon (2018). Conversely, recent work by Sohn and Wein (2025) provides evidence for the hardness part using the low-degree paradigm.
  In this paper we investigate community recovery in the regime $q=q_n \to \infty$ as $n\to\infty$ where no such predictions exist. We show that efficient inference of communities remains possible above the KS bound. Furthermore, we show that recovery of block models is low-degree hard below the KS bound when the number of communities satisfies $q\ll \sqrt{n}$. Perhaps surprisingly, we find that when $q \gg \sqrt{n}$, there is an efficient algorithm based on non-backtracking walks for recovery even below the KS bound. We identify a new threshold and ask if it is the threshold for efficient recovery in this regime. Finally, we show that detection is easy and identify (up to a constant) the information-theoretic threshold for community recovery as the number of communities $q$ diverges.
  Our low-degree hardness results also naturally have consequences for graphon estimation, improving results of Luo and Gao (2024).

title: SAS: Segment Anything Small for Ultrasound -- A Non-Generative Data Augmentation Technique for Robust Deep Learning in Ultrasound Imaging
summary: Accurate segmentation of anatomical structures in ultrasound (US) images, particularly small ones, is challenging due to noise and variability in imaging conditions (e.g., probe position, patient anatomy, tissue characteristics and pathology). To address this, we introduce Segment Anything Small (SAS), a simple yet effective scale- and texture-aware data augmentation technique designed to enhance the performance of deep learning models for segmenting small anatomical structures in ultrasound images. SAS employs a dual transformation strategy: (1) simulating diverse organ scales by resizing and embedding organ thumbnails into a black background, and (2) injecting noise into regions of interest to simulate varying tissue textures. These transformations generate realistic and diverse training data without introducing hallucinations or artifacts, improving the model's robustness to noise and variability. We fine-tuned a promptable foundation model on a controlled organ-specific medical imaging dataset and evaluated its performance on one internal and five external datasets. Experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in segmentation performance, with Dice score gains of up to 0.35 and an average improvement of 0.16 [95% CI 0.132,0.188]. Additionally, our iterative point prompts provide precise control and adaptive refinement, achieving performance comparable to bounding box prompts with just two points. SAS enhances model robustness and generalizability across diverse anatomical structures and imaging conditions, particularly for small structures, without compromising the accuracy of larger ones. By offering a computationally efficient solution that eliminates the need for extensive human labeling efforts, SAS emerges as a powerful tool for advancing medical image analysis, particularly in resource-constrained settings.

title: Mission-Aligned Learning-Informed Control of Autonomous Systems: Formulation and Foundations
summary: Research, innovation and practical capital investment have been increasing rapidly toward the realization of autonomous physical agents. This includes industrial and service robots, unmanned aerial vehicles, embedded control devices, and a number of other realizations of cybernetic/mechatronic implementations of intelligent autonomous devices. In this paper, we consider a stylized version of robotic care, which would normally involve a two-level Reinforcement Learning procedure that trains a policy for both lower level physical movement decisions as well as higher level conceptual tasks and their sub-components. In order to deliver greater safety and reliability in the system, we present the general formulation of this as a two-level optimization scheme which incorporates control at the lower level, and classical planning at the higher level, integrated with a capacity for learning. This synergistic integration of multiple methodologies -- control, classical planning, and RL -- presents an opportunity for greater insight for algorithm development, leading to more efficient and reliable performance. Here, the notion of reliability pertains to physical safety and interpretability into an otherwise black box operation of autonomous agents, concerning users and regulators. This work presents the necessary background and general formulation of the optimization framework, detailing each component and its integration with the others.

title: Higher-Order Kuramoto Oscillator Network for Dense Associative Memory
summary: Networks of phase oscillators can serve as dense associative memories when they incorporate genuine many-body coupling beyond the classical Kuramoto model's pairwise interaction. Here we introduce a generalized Hebbian Kuramoto model that combines a conventional two-body, first-Fourier-harmonic coupling with a genuine four-body phase interaction, inspired by dense Hopfield memory theory. For identical oscillators with Langevin noise, equilibrium mean-field theory yields a phase diagram with a tricritical point when the four-body coupling is three times the pairwise coupling, where continuous retrieval onset gives way to a discontinuous, hysteretic transition. We separately analyze a deterministic model with Lorentzian frequency disorder using the Ott--Antonsen ansatz. In that model the onset changes from supercritical to subcritical when the four-body coupling is six times the pairwise coupling, and the two descriptions agree only at the linear instability threshold. In the four-body-dominated equilibrium regime, stored-pattern and incoherent states coexist. We determine the bistable region and the free-energy barriers for transitions in both directions, and show that the noise-induced memory-loss time grows exponentially with the number of oscillators, with a rate set by the relevant barrier. At finite memory load, a phenomenological cavity signal--to--noise closure models pattern crosstalk, while simulations measure finite-size strong-cue recovery and retention thresholds. Nominal power-law fits over the simulated size range have exponents above one in several four-body-dominated cases, with the largest fitted exponent in the purely four-body zero-temperature data; these fits are not asymptotic capacity laws.

title: Distributional Sensitivity Analysis: Enabling Differentiability in Sample-Based Inference
summary: This work introduces a mathematical framework for estimating the space-parameter sensitivity of random samples in arbitrary dimensions. Such sensitivity effectively acts as gradients of random samples with respect to distributional parameters, which are essential in sample-based inverse problems in nuclear physics, such as inferring quantum correlation functions. We present two analytical formulae for sensitivity and gradient estimation. The first interprets sensitivity as the partial derivatives of the inverse mapping of 1-D conditional distributions. The second, suited for optimization methods that tolerate inexact gradients, applies a diagonal approximation that reduces computational cost with minimal accuracy loss. When closed forms are unavailable, four second-order numerical algorithms are provided to approximate both expressions. Verification and validation studies confirm the correctness of these algorithms and the effectiveness of the proposed formulae. A nuclear physics application demonstrates how the framework enables uncertainty quantification and parameter inference for quantum correlation functions. Unlike existing approaches, our method requires neither model fitting nor knowledge of sampling algorithms or high-dimensional integrals, making it suitable for black-box or simulation-based samplers. Moreover, it renders arbitrary sampling subroutines differentiable, facilitating integration into deep learning and automatic differentiation frameworks. Algorithmic details and open-source implementations are provided to ensure reproducibility and promote further development.

title: Programmable k-local Ising interactions and shallow optical Kolmogorov--Arnold networks through repeated data encounters
summary: Photonic processors are naturally suited to linear transformations, but independently programmable higher-order interactions usually require nonlinear media or a reduction to pairwise models. We introduce a repeated-encounter architecture that combines linear optical propagation with square-law detection to evaluate sparse and structured $k$-local Ising objectives. Each hyperedge is routed to a resolved channel, returned through the spin-dependent mask, and reconstructed from calibrated encounter-order signals. Within the stated architecture class, a $k$-spin Walsh term requires at least $\lceil k/2\rceil$ data encounters. A reciprocal rank-one recollection attains this bound for every finite order, allowing hyperedge identity, interaction order, and signed coupling to be programmed independently without quadratization ancillas or material optical nonlinearities. We test the $R=2$, $k=4$ member in a finite discrete-Fourier model of an ideal folded $4f$ relay. Reciprocal recollection produces the four-body response, whereas a fixed-patch control does not; configuration-level calibration measures the leakage caused by finite windows. Under signed-amplitude encoding, the same encounter hierarchy spans polynomial edge functions for shallow optical Kolmogorov--Arnold networks. The arbitrary-$k$ result is analytic; the finite Fourier calculation tests its two-encounter member and does not replace experimental validation.

title: Prob-GParareal: A Probabilistic Numerical Parallel-in-Time Solver for Differential Equations
summary: We introduce Prob-GParareal, a probabilistic extension of the GParareal algorithm designed to provide uncertainty quantification for the Parallel-in-Time (PinT) solution of (ordinary and partial) differential equations (ODEs, PDEs). The method employs Gaussian processes (GPs) to model the Parareal correction function, in line with GParareal, further enabling the propagation of numerical uncertainty across time and yielding probabilistic forecasts of the system's evolution. Furthermore, Prob-GParareal accommodates probabilistic initial conditions and maintains compatibility with classical numerical solvers, ensuring its straightforward integration into existing Parareal frameworks. Here, we first conduct a theoretical analysis of the computational complexity and derive error bounds of Prob-GParareal. Then, we numerically demonstrate the accuracy and robustness of the proposed algorithm on five benchmark ODE systems, including chaotic, stiff, and bifurcation problems. To showcase the flexibility and potential scalability of the proposed algorithm, we also consider Prob-nnGParareal, a variant obtained by replacing the GPs in Parareal with the nearest-neighbors GPs, illustrating its improved computational performance on an additional PDE example. This work bridges a critical gap in the development of probabilistic counterparts to established PinT methods.

title: Minimum Bisection Problem: Machine Learning-Based Penalty Parameter Tuning for Optimization on Quantum Annealers
summary: The Minimum Bisection Problem is a fundamental, computationally hard graph partitioning problem with applications in parallel computing, network design, and large-scale data processing. When formulated as a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization problem for quantum annealing, solution quality depends critically on the penalty parameter that enforces balanced partitions. Selecting this parameter is problem-dependent and typically relies on manual tuning or heuristics. This paper proposes a machine learning-based approach for automatic penalty-parameter tuning developed specifically for the Minimum Bisection Problem. We first derive a graph-dependent initial penalty estimate and then use two Gradient Boosting Regressor models to predict the endpoints of an effective penalty-multiplier interval from the number of nodes, graph density, and the initial estimate. The final penalty is obtained from the predicted interval and used to construct the model solved by D-Wave's quantum annealing solvers. The models were calibrated on 607 Erdős-Rényi graphs, with Metis and Kernighan-Lin as classical references, and evaluated on 126 independently generated instances with up to 4000 nodes. Under the adopted experimental setup, the predicted penalties enabled the hybrid solver to return balanced partitions for all evaluation instances and lower cut values than Metis in every case.

title: Classification of Small-size Quantum Secret Sharing Schemes using Uniform States
summary: We study the connection between quantum secret sharing (QSS) schemes and $k$-uniform states of qubits beyond the equivalence between threshold QSS schemes and AME states. Specifically, we show that $3$-uniformity is a necessary but not sufficient condition for constructing a $3$-homogeneous QSS scheme using states of qubits. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first result connecting \emph{non-threshold} QSS schemes with $k$-uniform states. As an application of our result, we classify QSS schemes for up to 7 players and provide explicit characterizations of their existence. Our results offer new insights into the role of $k$-uniform states in the design of QSS schemes (not necessarily threshold) and provide a foundation for future classifications of QSS schemes with more complex structures.

title: An interpretable universal bound for multiserver queues via a leave-one-out technique
summary:
Bounding the steady-state queue length of a multiserver queue is a central challenge in queueing theory. Even for the classical $GI/GI/n$ queue with homogeneous servers, obtaining a simple, accurate bound that holds across all parameters is highly non-trivial. A recent breakthrough by Li and Goldberg (2025) establishes the first universal bound of order $O(1/(1-ρ))$, holding for every load $ρ<1$ and server count $n$ -- an order known to be tight in many regimes, including classical heavy-traffic, Halfin-Whitt, and Non-Degenerate Slowdown. However, their bounds carry astronomically large constants and rely on an intricate proof; they conjecture that a far simpler bound holds.
  We introduce a leave-one-out coupling technique that yields a new universal $O(1/(1-ρ))$ bound for the $GI/GI/n$ queue, with a simple and transparent proof. Moreover, for light-tailed service times, the leading constant in our bound is orders of magnitude smaller than that in prior work. For instance, we bound the $M/GI/n$ queue's mean queue length by simply $1/(1-ρ)$ for New-Better-than-Used-in-Expectation service times, with similarly clean bounds for gamma, phase-type, and bounded service times.
  Finally, our techniques extend to $GI/GI/n$ queues with fully heterogeneous service-time distributions, a setting not addressed by prior universal bounds.

title: ABIDES-MARL: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Environment for Optimal Execution with Endogenous Liquidity
summary: Classical optimal execution models treat market impact as a pre-specified, exogenous process. However, when market makers adapt strategically, this assumption becomes a structural misspecification: execution dynamics depend on the policies and actions of other agents. The problem therefore ceases to be a single-agent control problem and instead becomes a finite-horizon stochastic game, in which liquidity emerges endogenously from the interactions among heterogeneous market players. We hence introduce ABIDES-MARL, a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for studying optimal execution under endogenous liquidity in a realistic limit order book setting. The framework extends ABIDES-Gym to support multiple learning agents with synchronized decision periods that preserve proper information filtration and key market microstructure features. We validate the framework in an extended Kyle setting, where multiple learning agents recovers gradual price discovery. Numerical results then show that execution strategies learned under endogenous, adaptive liquidity differ fundamentally from those implied by fixed exogenous price-impact benchmarks. In particular, strategies optimized under exogenous impact perform poorly once market makers adapt strategically: when information is not balanced across traders and market makers, market makers exploit predictable execution and the market dynamics may degenerate. The framework therefore provides a reproducible foundation for studying strategic adaptation in realistic markets and contributes to the development of economically interpretable agentic AI systems in finance.

title: On the relationship between MESP and 0/1 D-Opt and their upper bounds
summary: We establish strong connections between two fundamental nonlinear 0/1 optimization problems coming from the area of experimental design, namely maximum-entropy sampling and 0/1 D-optimality. The connections are based on maps between instances, and we analyze the behavior of these maps. Using these maps, we transport basic upper-bounding methods between these two problems. Further, we establish results relating how different branch-and-bound schemes based on these maps compare. Additionally, we observe some surprising numerical results, where bounding methods that did not seem promising in their direct application to real-data MESP instances, are now useful for MESP instances that come from 0/1 D-optimality.

title: DIGing--SGLD: Decentralized and Scalable Langevin Sampling over Time--Varying Networks
summary: Sampling from a target distribution induced by training data is central to Bayesian learning, with Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (SGLD) serving as a key tool for scalable posterior sampling and decentralized variants enabling learning when data are distributed across a network of agents. This paper introduces DIGing-SGLD, a decentralized SGLD algorithm designed for scalable Bayesian learning in multi-agent systems operating over time-varying networks. Existing decentralized SGLD methods are restricted to static network topologies, and many exhibit steady-state sampling bias caused by network effects, even when full batches are used. DIGing-SGLD overcomes these limitations by integrating Langevin-based sampling with the gradient-tracking mechanism of the DIGing algorithm, originally developed for decentralized optimization over time-varying networks, thereby enabling efficient and bias-free sampling without a central coordinator. To our knowledge, we provide the first finite-time non-asymptotic Wasserstein convergence guarantees for decentralized SGLD-based sampling over time-varying networks, with explicit constants. Under standard strong convexity and smoothness assumptions, DIGing-SGLD achieves geometric convergence to an $O(\sqrtη)$ neighborhood of the target distribution, where $η$ is the stepsize, with dependence on the target accuracy matching the best-known rates for centralized and static-network SGLD algorithms using constant stepsize. Numerical experiments on Bayesian linear and logistic regression validate the theoretical results and demonstrate the strong empirical performance of DIGing-SGLD under dynamically evolving network conditions.

title: MOCLIP: A Foundation Model for Large-Scale Nanophotonic Inverse Design
summary: Foundation models (FM) are transforming artificial intelligence by enabling generalizable, data-efficient solutions across different domains for a broad range of applications. However, the lack of large and diverse datasets limits the development of FM in nanophotonics. This work presents MOCLIP (Metasurface Optics Contrastive Learning Pretrained), a nanophotonic foundation model that integrates metasurface geometry and spectra within a shared latent space. MOCLIP employs contrastive learning to align geometry and spectral representations using an experimentally acquired dataset with a sample density comparable to ImageNet-1K. The study demonstrates MOCLIP inverse design capabilities for high-throughput zero-shot prediction at a rate of 0.2 million samples per second, enabling the design of a full 4-inch wafer populated with high-density metasurfaces in minutes. It also shows generative latent-space optimization reaching 97 percent accuracy. Finally, we introduce an optical information storage concept that uses MOCLIP to achieve a density of 0.1 Gbit per square millimeter at the resolution limit, exceeding commercial optical media by a factor of six. These results position MOCLIP as a scalable and versatile platform for next-generation photonic design and data-driven applications.

title: Particle Image Velocimetry Refinement via Consensus ADMM for Active Fluid Control
comments: Accepted for presentation at, and publication in the proceedings of, the 2026 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC). Code available at https://github.com/antonioterpin/flowgym
summary: Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) is among the central modalities for measuring flow fields across laboratory, industrial and environmental setting. Traditional PIV approaches typically depend on tuning parameters specific to the imaging setup, making the performance sensitive to variations in illumination, flow conditions, and seeding density. Similarly, state-of-the-art machine learning methods for flow quantification are fragile outside their training set. In our experiments, we observed that flow quantification would improve if different tunings (or algorithms) were applied to different regions of the same image pair. Motivated by this observation, we thus pose flow quantification as a multi-estimator fusion problem: several heterogeneous algorithms process the same image pair in parallel, and their dense flow fields are treated as complementary estimates. To fuse them, we adopt a consensus framework based on the alternating direction method of multipliers, incorporating priors such as smoothness and incompressibility. We perform several numerical experiments to demonstrate the benefits of this approach. For instance, we achieve a decrease in end-point-error of up to 20% of a dense-inverse-search estimator at an inference rate of 60Hz, and we show how performance can be increased with outlier rejection. Our method is implemented in JAX and integrated into Flow Gym, enabling reproducible comparisons with the state of the art and systematic evaluation across different base algorithms. Finally, we demonstrate successful deployment of our method in the same real-world active-fluids-control setup of Terpin and D'Andrea [1], where a reinforcement-learning agent uses our flow estimates to learn to minimize drag (down by 36%) or maximize it (up to 32%) with only two minutes of real-world interaction. Hardware and software are made available at ActiveFluidControl.com.

title: Well-VE-Dominated Graphs
summary: Vertex-edge domination is a natural variant of domination in which a vertex ve-dominates an edge whenever it is incident to the edge or adjacent to one of its endpoints. A set of vertices is a vedominating set if it ve-dominates every edge of the graph. In this paper, we introduce the notion of wellve- dominated graphs, namely graphs in which all minimal ve-dominating sets have the same cardinality. Equivalently, these are graphs whose minimal isolating sets all have the same cardinality; we refer to them as well-isolated graphs. We prove that recognizing well-ve-dominated graphs is co-NP-complete. We determine perfectly well-ve-dominated graphs, the largest hereditary subclass, and obtain both a complete forbidden induced subgraph characterization and a linear-time recognition algorithm. In particular, every connected nontrivial member of this subclass has vertex-edge domination and isolation number one. Finally, we characterize the class of well-ve-dominated trees. More precisely, we prove that well-ve-domination and well-ve-coveredness coincide on nontrivial trees, where well-ve-coveredness requires all minimal independent ve-dominating sets to have the same cardinality. The characterization yields a linear-time recognition algorithm and identifies the reduced members with the extremal trees attaining equality in the sharp isolation bound.

title: First-Principles AI finds crystallization of fractional quantum Hall liquids
comments: 5 pages + SM. Published version in PRX Intelligence
summary: When does a fractional quantum Hall (FQH) liquid crystallize? Addressing this question requires a framework that treats fractionalization and crystallization on equal footing, especially in strong Landau-level mixing regime. Here, we introduce MagNet, a self-attention neural-network variational wavefunction designed for quantum systems in magnetic fields on the torus geometry. We show that MagNet provides a unifying and expressive ansatz capable of describing both FQH states and electron crystals within the same architecture. Trained solely by energy minimization of the microscopic Hamiltonian, MagNet discovers topological liquid and electron crystal ground states across a broad range of Landau-level mixing. Our results highlight the power of first-principles AI for solving strongly interacting many-body problems and finding competing phases without external training data or physics pre-knowledge.

title: Wideband Compressed-Domain Cramér-Rao Bounds for Near-Field XL-MIMO: Data and Geometric Diversity Decomposition
comments: 8 pages (incl. IEEE notice), 5 figures. Accepted for publication in GLOBECOM 2026 - 2026 IEEE Global Communications Conference. Supersedes v3. v4 adds required IEEE copyright notice post-acceptance; corrects Fig. 3 reference distance (EBRD, not r_RD/8) per Hussain et al., IEEE TWC 2025
summary: Wideband orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) over near-field extremely large-scale MIMO (XL-MIMO) arrays couples beam squint and wavefront curvature, and existing single-frequency compressed covariance models are severely biased as a result. To the best of our knowledge, no compressed-domain Cramér-Rao bound (CRB) has been reported for this regime under hybrid analog-digital architectures; existing wideband near-field bounds assume full-array observation. We derive the wideband compressed-domain CRB and decompose its Fisher information gain into two terms: a dominant data-diversity term, exactly 10 log10(K_s) dB, where K_s denotes the number of independent subcarrier observations, and we prove that for a centred array the full-array range bound is invariant to beam squint, so the full-array wideband gain equals the data-diversity term to within 3x10^-4 dB. Under hybrid compression, however, this invariance breaks: the residual is a combiner-dependent fluctuation of either sign rather than a propagation-geometry effect, with mean +0.157 dB and standard deviation 0.767 dB over 385 realizations at N_RF = 16, B = 400 MHz, and its spread shrinks toward zero as the number of RF chains grows. At 28 GHz with B = 400 MHz, data diversity contributes +27.1 dB and hybrid compression contributes an additional 12.6 dB gap relative to the full-array bound at N_RF = 16 RF chains. Frequency-aware covariance modeling is therefore the dominant requirement, and the residual is a property of the analog front end rather than of the propagation geometry.

title: A Unified Control-Theoretic Framework for Saddle-Point Dynamics in Constrained Optimization
summary: This paper studies equality-constrained minimization problems through the lens of feedback control. We introduce a unified control-theoretic framework by showing that a PID feedback law acting on the dual variable induces the PID saddle-point flow (PID-SPF), a broad class of saddle-point dynamics associated with the augmented Lagrangian. This framework recovers several classical primal-dual flows as special cases. We prove that the equilibria of the proposed flow coincide with the stationary points of the original problem. Our analysis reveals how the feedback gains affect the optimization: integral action enforces constraint satisfaction, proportional action introduces the augmented Lagrangian structure, and derivative action modifies the geometry of the primal dynamics by inducing a state-dependent Riemannian metric. Moreover, for convex problems with affine constraints, we establish global exponential convergence by leveraging contraction theory for all admissible PID gains, providing in the process explicit bounds on the convergence rate. Finally, we validate our theoretical results on numerical examples including an application to bilevel optimization.

comments: This paper has been accepted to IEEE GLOBECOM 2026
summary: The Tactile Internet demands sub-millisecond latency and ultra-high reliability, as even slight latency or packet loss can destabilize haptic control. title: Tumor-aware augmentation with task-guided attention analysis improves rectal cancer segmentation from magnetic resonance images
comments: Accepted to Biomedical Signal Processing & Control 2026
summary: Although self-supervised pretraining is expected to learn broadly transferable representations, its effectiveness across imaging modalities substantially different from the pretraining domain, and on complex tumor-segmentation tasks, remains understudied. Evaluating CT-pretrained transformers on MRI rectal cancer segmentation, we identified two interacting failure modes in CT-to-MRI transfer: (a) inefficient token usage caused by zero-padding to match pretrained input dimensions, and (b) ineffective feature adaptation. We investigated these vulnerabilities using two primary CT-pretrained hierarchical shifted-window transformer backbones, SMIT and Swin UNETR, together with VoCo as a large-scale-pretrained supporting benchmark; these models differ in pretraining objectives and datasets. Mechanistic analysis leveraged an attention dilution index (ADI), an entropy-based metric quantifying attention diverted toward uninformative padding tokens, and centered kernel alignment (CKA) to measure feature reuse during MRI adaptation. ADI increased with zero-padding, while high feature reuse did not necessarily translate to improved downstream accuracy. To mitigate these issues, we introduced two interventions: a tumor-aware augmentation strategy to expand tumor appearance heterogeneity coverage, and an anisotropic cropping strategy to restore token efficiency. Fine-tuning with these strategies on identical rectal MRI datasets yielded detection rates of 91.1% (225/247) and 88.7% (219/247) for the primary SMIT and Swin UNETR backbones, with the supporting VoCo benchmark reaching 90.3% (223/247), demonstrating significantly improved robustness under CT-to-MRI transfer. This study is among the first to examine when pretrained transformers fail to transfer across imaging modalities and demonstrates how targeted mitigation strategies can systematically overcome cross-modality transfer limitations.

title: Guaranteed cost structured control in infinite-horizon linear-quadratic cooperative differential games
comments: This extended version was accepted for the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026)
summary: In this paper, we consider the infinite-horizon linear-quadratic cooperative differential games with output feedback information structure. We first show that computing Pareto optimal controls under output feedback is difficult even for low-dimensional games. To address this, we introduce the concept of feedback guaranteed cost structured control (GCSC). At a feedback GCSC, the total weighted team cost remains below a prescribed threshold while satisfying the structural constraint. We derive monotonicity properties of the feedback GCSC set and the admissible weight set, respectively. Further, we show that Pareto optimal controls (if they exist) belong to the class of feedback GCSCs. We provide performance measures of the Pareto optimal controls and the proposed GCSC relative to the output feedback optimal control. We also establish verification and synthesis conditions for a feedback GCSC using linear matrix inequalities, where the synthesis formulation is convex and requires no semi-definite programming relaxation. Finally, we illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach through numerical examples, including a microgrid tracking synchronization case study.
